facts.fact: The 2026 finance law (loi n°021-2025/ALT of 27 December 2025) appropriates XOF 1,187,169,000 in domestic payment credits to programme 095, Development of electronic communications infrastructure, of the digital ministry (MTD-PCE), covering the government backbone, broadband access and the PACTDIGITAL project; the figure is a floor, as counterpart funding is not apportioned.
facts.system: MTD-PCE programme 095, Développement d'infrastructures de communications électroniques, budget year 2026

note: Only one budget year (2026) is given, so no rose or fell fact.
